works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: 理疗与患者康复平台仪表盘：浅色界面配蓝色点缀，左侧导航，预约、康复评分与数据图表并排呈现；医疗后台把“患者进度”做成一眼读懂的评分与图表组合，信息密度高却不乱，值得参考。
works.comment_en: Physiotherapy and patient-recovery dashboard: a light interface with blue accents, left navigation, and appointments, recovery scores and charts laid out side by side — a good example of turning patient progress into scores and charts that read at a glance without feeling crowded.
works.title: Healthcare Dashboard – Physiotherapy & Patient Recovery Platform

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 移动电商购物车流程：深棕黑底的三屏并排展示，从商品页、购物车到结账一气呵成；深色时尚电商里“流程即展示”的排布方式，讲转化路径时很直观。
works.comment_en: Mobile e-commerce cart flow: three screens side by side on a dark brown-black backdrop, walking from product page to cart to checkout in one sweep — a neat "the flow is the showcase" layout for telling a conversion story in dark, fashion-forward e-commerce.
works.title: Mobile Ecommerce - Shopping Cart Flow

works.author: vino_costa for Roobinium
works.comment: AI SaaS 落地页 OmniAgent：深色底配紫色光晕，大标题“一个 AI Agent 搞定所有工作流”，下方直接放仪表盘界面；AI 产品首屏“口号 + 真实界面”的组合，可信度比纯概念图高一截。
works.comment_en: OmniAgent AI SaaS landing page: a dark hero with a purple glow, the headline "One AI Agent for every workflow", and the actual dashboard interface right below — pairing the promise with the real product makes the first screen far more credible than a concept-only visual.
works.title: AI SaaS Landing Page Design for OmniAgent

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 贷款审批软件工作台：荧光绿大标题“离委员会拍板只差一步”，下方深色仪表盘并排申请队列、信用评分与抵押物覆盖；金融后台用高对比配色把审批进度做成一眼能推进的状态板。
works.comment_en: Loan-origination software workbench: a neon-green headline, "One check from committee", over a dark dashboard showing the application queue, a 4-out-of-5 credit score and collateral coverage — high-contrast color turns approval progress into a status board you can read at a glance.
works.title: Loan Origination Software Web App Design

works.author: Alamin Hossen
works.comment: 现代银行官网 Orvia：浅灰绿底，大标题“好用也要好看”，中央绿、金、黑三张 3D 信用卡叠放，左侧配储蓄对比条形图；金融官网用 3D 卡片做视觉锚点、数据图表做信任背书的组合很完整。
works.comment_en: Orvia modern banking website: a light gray-green page headlined "Banking that looks as good as it works", with green, gold and black 3D credit cards stacked at the center and a savings-comparison bar chart on the side — 3D cards as the visual anchor plus charts as trust signals, a complete fintech homepage formula.
works.title: Orvia – Modern Banking Website Design | 3D Fintech UI & Motion

works.author: NexUX Product for Nexux Lab
works.comment: 健康追踪 App：浅粉底三屏并排，中央红色解剖心脏 3D 图很抢眼，右侧人体肌肉图配心率、血压数据；健康类 App 用一枚强烈的 3D 视觉符号统领全屏，数据再跟着走，记忆点很足。
works.comment_en: Health and wellness tracker app: three screens on a soft pink backdrop, led by a striking red anatomical-heart 3D render in the center, with a muscle map and heart-rate and blood-pressure data alongside — one bold 3D symbol carries the whole screen while the metrics follow, a memorable formula for health apps.
works.title: Health & Wellness Tracker Mobile App
